_how: Powers the 'Brands I've broken down' wall and the world map on the home page. To add a video: put it in 'videos' (id: title + date), then reference its id from a brand and/or from each country it covers. Brand 'verdict' is one of: rise, comeback, fall, threat, power. Countries use 2-letter codes (IN, US, CN...) with a pin position in degrees (lon, lat). The first 8 brands in the list are the ones shown before 'Show all' is clicked, so order them best first.
